svg.aria-label: Map of the valley: three rings of forest around the camp, a stream, and the beacon at the far edge
svg.title: Map of the valley: three rings of forest around the camp, a stream, and the beacon at the far edge
svg.text: Three rings around your camp. Further out,
the finds are richer and the nights darker.
Close to the fire, and safe.
Amber, and the three pieces of the
beacon's lens. More wolves at night.
At the far edge. It never moves,
and it's been dark since last winter.
